notes.title: 🛡️ Warchief Selected for Steam Strategy Fest - New Demo Await! 🛡️
notes.content:
Hey Warchief,

We're ecstatic to announce that Warchief is part of this year's [b]Steam Neo Strategy Fest[/b], a festival that puts the spotlight on the best and brightest in strategic gaming. We are honored and thrilled to be part of this.

 [b]🎮Play the Stunning New Demo[/b]
Mark your calendars! [b]Starting this Monday, August 28th[/b], a brand-new demo version of Warchief will be available for you to play. This demo showcases not just gameplay enhancements but also major visual upgrades that bring a new level of beauty and immersion to the game.

[b]⚒️ What’s New in the Demo?[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Visuals:[/b] We've reworked the aesthetics of cards, avatars, and maps. The game has never looked this good.
[*] [b]Gameplay Balance:[/b] A slew of tweaks and changes to make gameplay more balanced and enjoyable.
[*] [b]Randomized Buildings:[/b] 6 random buildings now appear near each jungle camp for more strategic depth.
[*] [b]Strategic Spawning:[/b] Units can now only spawn near your Warchief and building areas.
[/list]

[b]📅 Event Timeline[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Demo Availability:[/b] From August 28, 10:00 AM PDT to September 4, 10:00 AM PDT.
[*] [b]Developer Play Sessions:[/b] That’s right, I'll be in-game to face off against you. Let's see who has mastered their strategy!
[/list]

[b]📣 Let's Make Some Noise![/b]
We're pumped, and you should be too! Share this news far and wide. Let's make this Steam Neo Fest one to remember!

[b]🎖️ The Battlefield is More Gorgeous Than Ever[/b]
So suit up and get ready to deploy your units on our newly beautified battlefield. Your Warchief is waiting.

Join our Discord for real-time updates and community fun : https://discord.gg/T9Undpq

GL HF, 
Honikou

notes.title: THE BATTLE BEGINS: SUBTOURNAMENT 1st EDITION 🏆
notes.content:
[i]Subtournament : 1st edition [July 30, 2021 | 20h] [/i]

[h1]THE FIRST BIG BATTLE IS COMING, THE SUBTOURNAMENT OPENS ITS DOORS FOR ITS FIRST EDITION! [/h1]

What better way to mark the launch of this beta than with this beautiful event?  

The concept is very simple, [b]16 streamers[/b] will train for 1 week on the new version of Warchief and compete in a tournament to get the ultimate reward : [b]1 000 subs[/b] ! 

The event will of course be streamed on the channel of each participant, [b]on Twitch on July 30th 2021[/b], book your friday night ! 

Who will be the winner? There will be only one Warchief left! ⚔️

notes.title: THE WARCHIEF BETA IS COMING, DON'T MISS IT ! ⚔️
notes.content:
[h1]NEW BETA APPROACHING[/h1]

These last few months, all our efforts have been focused on the production of the new version of Warchief. We really wanted to offer a much more complete game in terms of aesthetics, ergonomics and gameplay! And we did it ! Well, almost, we still have a few days left to work on it ! 

Many additions redefine Warchief today! All these improvements will be available in the new version of the game which will be released .....[b]on JULY 23rd 2021[/b] ! So you still have some time to prepare yourself, and warn all your companions of this imminent battle!  

To participate, nothing could be easier! You just have to request access on the Steam page of the game!

notes.title: The closed beta pre-test is open: join the adventure!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are proud to announce that the closed beta pre-test is officially launched! You can now join us on the game!

To be part of the adventure, nothing could be simpler: 
- Join the [url=https://discord.gg/FXwumbDa5v]Discord[/url] Warchief and express yourself in the chat;
- Beta keys will be distributed to you and you will have access to the game ! 

The goal is to start collecting feedback from players to offer an improved closed beta by the end of May 2021! 

The adventure begins, the battlefield awaits you in Warchief! ⚔️

notes.title: Warchief was at Games Made In France 2020!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

There was [url=https://jeuxmadeinfrance.fr/fr]Games Made In France 2020[/url] this week-end, an online event introducing and highlighting French video games. Famous streamers like Mistermv, Maghla, Atomium and Damdamlive provided the entertainment!

And off course, Warchief was here last Friday with Mistermv and Maghla. Guillaume Faia, the game developer, was here too for the occasion. The joy of seeing this project become concrete was clearly visible on his face!

[h2]The program included:[/h2]
[list]
[*]A first versus between the 2 streamers, allowing to explain pedagogically the game ; 
[*]A second versus, a real fight, godless and lawless, where the winner receives a big reward!
[/list]
We won't spoil the winner, so check out the [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/786392560?t=09h57m42s]REPLAY[/url][/b]!

[olist]
[*][b][url=https://discord.gg/u9WMxck]Join the Warchief Discord[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=https://warchief.net/]Sign up to the beta[/url][/b]
[/olist]
